gen-gf-slackey-bitter: Slackey is sturdy and widely spaced, its horizontals a shade lighter. Bitter, a slab-serif, grounds all that personality with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see straight through.
gen-gf-slackey-inter: Expressive Slackey stands tall and sturdy with generous gaps between letters, its strokes thickening and thinning in small gentle steps. Inter is the opposite: tidy, tube-smooth lines cut at a single width.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-inter: Broad-nibbed and a little wild, Syne Tactile bumps gently up to its capitals with a pen stroke that never curls shut. Inter follows with flat, unmodulated lines, leaving the pen-drawn heading room to stand out.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-mulish: Mulish reads friendly and open, its horseshoe-shaped apertures never pinching closed. Above it, Syne Tactile brings a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, while the sans below keeps every line uniform.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-roboto-slab: Syne Tactile writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, bumping up gently at capitals. Roboto Slab then settles into a firm, structured texture where the middle of the line dominates.
gen-gf-tauri-fs-literata: Contemporary Tauri keeps its sans-serif letters plain and modern, with nothing fussy in the way. And Literata, a serif, adds a bookish touch with sturdy thin lines, slightly heavier thick ones and wide, unclosed curves.
gen-gf-text-me-one-fs-literata: Text Me One packs its characters as close as pins in a cushion, yet keeps every letter mouth distinctly open. Literata's soft thick-thin difference gives the text a bookish, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-tilt-prism-mulish: Bold one-tip simplicity defines Tilt Prism, every glyph drawn with a single point. Mulish then relaxes into modern, approachable letters with no thick-and-thin modulation, a large x-height and short ascenders.
gen-gf-tiro-bangla-fs-bespoke-sans: Fat strokes against slender ones: Tiro Bangla has a dignified, classic pull, with a wide gap between stem and hairline. Bespoke Sans stays sharp, leaving generous space at its curve ends.
gen-gf-tiro-devanagari-sanskrit-fs-bespo: Refined Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit splits its strokes into bold downstrokes and whisper-thin upstrokes, a literary heavy-light rhythm. Bespoke Sans reads sharp, its curve ends spaced generously from the stem.
